role: nomination-time explanation of failed V5 constant pairs using retained traces
registration_context: V5 three-season outcomes and first-failure times observed; receipt-prefix classifications for these V5 histories unobserved

roster.selection_basis: original constant levels bracketing the prior inverse unit-1 range and nearest the unit-2 range; chosen for explanation, not as a performance-selected shortlist
roster.population: dependent, overlapping development windows; all V5 library outcomes remain retained

procedure.trace: read the existing compressed V5 first-failure contexts and matching windows.csv; do not reconstruct stocks with another controller rollout
procedure.known_path: at the saved decision stock, execute the two pending nominations and actual new nomination under only BOA revisions already received at that decision
procedure.actual_path: reconstruct the same prefix through its saved first failing piece using actual BOA revisions
procedure.classification: reuse classify_failure to distinguish known pending-hour violation, known new-delivery violation, later receipt path change and unresolved trace discrepancy
procedure.accounting: preserve causes, absolute event times and changed-receipt times; the actual prefix must reproduce the saved first physical failure
procedure.report: counts by candidate and event with first examples; no target fitting or new policy search

decision: if discrepancies occur, repair the trace linkage before interpretation; known new-delivery failures direct attention to causal physical projection; later receipt changes direct attention to the information/commitment model and predictive inputs before any further controller revision. Neither branch proves online impossibility
limitations: two development-selected constant pairs and overlapping histories; classifications explain their realized first failures, not every V5 policy or a causal policy's achievable reliability; full source comparison stays HOLD
